info.title: ServCrafty API
info.description: REST API of the ServCrafty game-server panel. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer scf_...` (create a token in Account > API tokens). A token has exactly the permissions of its owner. Errors always look like `{"error":{"code","message"}}`. A token cannot create other tokens, change passwords or manage MFA/passkeys (those need a browser session). Admin tokens without 2FA are refused from outside the LAN when the LAN-only rule is configured. The live WebSocket (`/ws`, outside `/api`) is described in the guide.

put.description: Requires **manager** access. Enabling creates a PostgreSQL schema and a role of their own for the server (`400 bluemap_db_privileges` if the panel's database user may not create them, `400 bluemap_db_unreachable` if the database host cannot be reached from game containers, `400 bluemap_eula_required` without `acceptDownload`, `400 bluemap_unsupported` for other server types). BlueMap is installed at the next start of the server (`restartRequired`). Disabling keeps the stored map unless `deleteData` is true (`409 server_running` while the server runs).

post.description: Requires **manager** access and a stopped server (`409 server_running`). BlueMap renders the world again at the next start.

put.description: Requires **manager** access. Multipart upload of one PNG that is exactly 64x64 pixels and at most 256 KB (`400 invalid_icon` otherwise). Minecraft reads the icon at startup (`restartRequired`).

bearerAuth.description: API token created in the UI (Account > API tokens), sent as `Authorization: Bearer scf_...`.

FilePath.name: path
FilePath.description: Path relative to the server directory (confined to it; `..` is refused).

DirPath.name: path
DirPath.description: Directory relative to the server directory. Empty = root.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, expired or LAN-blocked token (`unauthorized`); or `mfa_required` for a pending cookie session.

NotFound.description: Unknown resource, or a server you have no access to (`server_not_found`, ...).

TooMany.description: Rate limited (`rate_limited`). Only login, MFA and update-check are limited.

details.description: Optional extra data, e.g. the list of zod issues for `validation_error`.

ServerType.description: Minecraft Java: VANILLA, PAPER, PURPUR, FOLIA, SPIGOT, BUKKIT, FABRIC, QUILT, FORGE, NEOFORGE, CURSEFORGE, MODRINTH. Minecraft Bedrock: BEDROCK. Terraria: TERRARIA, TSHOCK, TMODLOADER. Any SteamCMD game: STEAMCMD (with a `steam` object).

canAuthorGames.description: May create and edit custom SteamCMD game definitions.

allowedGames.description: Game keys the user may create servers for (`minecraft`, `terraria`, `steam:<id>`); null = unrestricted (admins). Added in v0.3.2.

limits.description: Host-wide caps set by the admin.

authVia.description: Always `token` when you authenticate with a Bearer token.

prefix.description: First characters of the token (`scf_` plus 6), to recognise it. The secret is never shown again.

levelType.description: Java: default, flat, largebiomes, amplified, single_biome_surface. Bedrock: default, flat, legacy.

generatorSettings.description: JSON object as a string. Java only.

extra.description: Other safe `server.properties` keys (lowercase). Ports, RCON, IP and management keys are rejected.

MinecraftConfig.description: Initial Minecraft settings, applied only on the FIRST start (before server.properties exists). Options that do not exist on the edition give 400 `invalid_minecraft_config`.

worldFile.description: World file to load (set by the world import).

TerrariaConfig.description: Terraria settings (unknown keys are rejected with 400 `invalid_terraria_config`).

gameId.description: Id of a game definition (`GET /games`), e.g. `satisfactory`, `rust`.

vars.description: Values of the game definition variables (keys are defined by the game; see `GET /games`). Unknown keys or invalid values give 400 `invalid_steam_config`. Generated secrets are created for you when omitted.
Merged over the current values; null returns a variable to its default.

mcVersion.description: Minecraft only. Other games accept only `LATEST`.

memoryMb.description: Games have their own minimum (SteamCMD games: the definition minimum).

port.description: Main host port. Default: first free port of the pool. Not allowed for STEAMCMD servers (400 `port_not_supported`).

eula.description: Required (`true`) for Minecraft and Terraria servers; not needed for STEAMCMD.

ownerId.description: Admins only: create the server for another user.

CreateServer.description: A field that belongs to another game is rejected with 400 `unsupported_game`.

terraria.description: Merged over the current config; null resets to defaults.

UpdateServer.description: All fields optional (partial update). Requires manager access.

steam.description: SteamCMD config `{gameId, vars, workshop, updateOnStart, validateNext}`. Secret variables are blanked below manager access.

extraPorts.description: Other published ports of a SteamCMD game, by port id.

steamGame.description: What the game definition offers (ports, workshop, webui, console, players). null for non-Steam servers.

access.description: Your access level on this server.

restartRequired.description: Only in PATCH responses: true when the server runs and a changed field needs a restart.

icon.description: Version (file mtime, ms) of the Java server icon, used as `?v=` on `/servers/{id}/icon`; null = no icon.

output.description: Command output (RCON). Terraria/Steam consoles are fire-and-forget and return what the server prints immediately, often empty.

install.description: SteamCMD install/update progress while status is `installing`.

config.description: Server configuration (same fields as POST /servers, plus optional `properties`).
Server configuration (`name`, `port`, `eula`, `ownerId` are not part of it; `properties` map optional).

eula.description: Required unless the template is a SteamCMD server.

files.description: Paths (relative to the server directory) that were saved.

keep.description: Backups: how many scheduled backups to keep.

warnSeconds.description: Announce to players this many seconds before restart/stop.

cron.description: Standard cron expression (5 fields, or 6 with seconds), validated by node-cron. Invalid: 400 `invalid_cron`.

url.description: Public http(s) URL (private/loopback addresses are refused).

replace.description: File name of an installed mod to replace (update).

items.description: A world file found in the server Worlds directory.

key.description: A variable of the definition marked as generated.

WorkshopSearch.description: Page of Workshop results `{items, total, page, ...}`.

disabled.description: v0.3.2: an admin disabled this game for new servers.

blockStart.description: v0.3.2: existing servers of this game cannot be started.

GameSummary.description: A game definition without its scripts. Contains `variables` (key, type, default, required, generate...), `ports`, `resources` (memoryMb, memoryMinMb, cpu, diskMb), `workshop`, `webui`, ... See docs/games.md.

GameDefinition.description: A game definition (JSON, see docs/games.md in the repository for the schema).

CatalogSearch.description: Search result page `{items, total, ...}` from CurseForge, Modrinth or Hangar.

disabled.description: Disabling a user also deletes all of their API tokens and sessions.

lanNetworks.description: Comma-separated CIDR list; non-empty enables the LAN-only rule for admins without 2FA.

globalLimits.description: Host-wide caps `{maxServers, maxRamMb, maxCpu, maxDiskMb}` (null = none).

bluemapDbHost.description: `host` or `host:port` that game containers use to reach PostgreSQL for BlueMap. Empty = the host of DATABASE_URL.
`host` or `host:port` that game containers use to reach PostgreSQL for BlueMap. Empty = the host of DATABASE_URL.

SystemInfo.description: Panel, host, Docker, disk, database and counts information.

UpdateInfo.description: Self-update state (current/latest version, running servers, progress). LXC installs only apply updates.

UserGames.description: v0.3.2. For an admin user `games` is null and `unrestricted` true.

blockStart.description: Also stop running servers and refuse to start existing ones.

Processes.description: Process snapshot `{takenAt, intervalMs, host, servers:[{serverId, name, game, gameKey, status, containerId, cpuPercent, memUsedMb, memLimitMb, processes:[{pid, ppid, user, cpuPercent, memMb, memPercent, state, elapsedSec, cpuTimeSec, command}]}], dockerAvailable}`. Read-only; secrets in command lines are redacted.

supported.description: The server type can run BlueMap (Paper, Purpur, Folia, Spigot, Fabric, Quilt, Forge, NeoForge).

dataBytes.description: Size of the server's map data in the database (kept while BlueMap is disabled); null when there is none.

dbIssue.description: Why enabling would fail: the database host is not reachable from game containers (an administrator sets the BlueMap database address in settings).

restartRequired.description: The running server must restart for the last change to apply.

url.description: Browser URL of the proxied map (needs a signed-in browser session); null when not enabled.

acceptDownload.description: Required (true) when enabling: BlueMap downloads the Minecraft client from Mojang, so Mojang's EULA must be accepted.

deleteData.description: When disabling: also delete the server's map data (its schema and role). The server must be stopped.
